title: Starter flow snapshot sheet: Hosted API model-select + request composer visuals
creator: Maya Rios
description: Design deliverable: a compact, annotated snapshot sheet for the Hosted API getting-started flow. This ticket collects final artboards and annotated screenshots for the docs quickstart and product release notes. Focus areas: (1) model selector variations for presenting curated model profiles and fallback hints, (2) inline request composer UI with example prompts and structured-output toggle, (3) three code snippet formats (curl, python, javascript) with copy-to-clipboard affordances and live streaming indicator. Deliverable must be export-ready for docs/images and a separate slice for marketing PNGs.
comments: 2025-02-10 - Maya Rios: Ticket created. Initial brief captures scope from PD and Docs: need a single-sheet artifact that covers three micro-interactions in the hosted api quickstart.
2025-02-11 - Kai Nguyen: Working on first-pass Figma frames. Prioritizing mobile breakpoint for new console sidebar compactness.

2025-02-12 - Sumit Patel (PM): Reviewed frames; requested stronger affordance for streaming vs non-streaming (suggest add live dot + estimated latency). Also asked for an accessibility contrast pass on token counter.

2025-02-14 - Kai Nguyen: Added request-composer states (empty prompt, example prompt filled from snippet picker, error state for rate limit) and a microcopy suggestion for model tooltips describing cost/latency tradeoffs.

2025-02-15 - Eng review (Priya Das): Raised note about API param naming differences between SDK samples and backend: code snippets should use 'model' not 'model_name' to match runtime-1.18. Also recommend showing both 'stream: true' and streaming-safe snippet for SSE consumption.

2025-02-16 - Design critique: Small layout change approved — swap code tab order to show Python first (most used by internal users), JS second, curl third. Marked color palette tokens for docs-export.

decisions: Single-sheet artifact will be used for both product docs and the console release notes; derivatives will be exported at 2x and 3x sizes.
Use Python-first code tab order based on telemetry and PM request.
Model selector will show curated profile badges (latency / cost / opti) instead of raw architecture names to simplify onboarding.
Streaming indicator will be a green pulsing dot + 'Live' label and an estimated latency microcopy derived from runtime bench dataset (rounded to nearest 50ms).
engineering_notes: Code snippet alignment: ensure SDK examples use the same client import path as runtime-1.18 docs (redwood.inference.client).
Backend field names: 'model', 'temperature', 'max_tokens', 'stream' — docs must match exact API keys.
Streaming snippet: include both SSE example (curl --no-buffer) and JS EventSource consumer pattern for clarity.
Rate-limit state: design includes a 429 error overlay; engineering to provide sample error body shape for accurate copy (fields: code, message, retry_after_seconds).
review_feedback: Docs (Asha Chen): Please shorten the code comments to one-liners and add a link to 'model catalog' in the snippet area.
Accessibility (Noah Stein): Increase contrast on the token counter background to pass AA small text. Update exported PNGs accordingly.
PM (Sumit Patel): Add a small note near the model selector: 'Recommended for quick prototypes' for the default curated model.
Security (Lena Wu): Confirm that no real API keys are present in exports and that placeholders use <REDACTED_API_KEY> pattern.
accept_criteria: One export-ready PNG (1200x700) of the single-sheet quickstart artifact.
Three code tabs (Python, JavaScript, curl) included and copy-clip icons visible in the image.
Model selector variant showing curated badges and a tooltip example.
Docs PR created with images attached and sample alt-text for each screenshot.
next_steps: Finalize alt-text and captions for each exported image (Owner: Docs).
QA exported images on staging docs site and verify mobile breakpoint cropping (Owner: Design).
Merge docs PR and tag release notes; coordinate with marketing for a trimmed PNG variant (Owner: PM).
